description: Comprehensive UX design companion based on all 30 Laws of UX from lawsofux.com. Analyzes components being built and recommends which laws apply with specific code-level fixes. Works as proactive advisor during frontend development and reactive auditor on demand. Use when building or reviewing UI/UX — designing layouts, choosing interactions, organizing information, evaluating interface decisions, or when user mentions "UX laws", "laws of ux", "lawsofux", "UX audit", "UX review", "UX checklist", "check UX", "apply UX", "design review", "UI review", "pre-ship check". Also triggers alongside the frontend-design skill. Do NOT trigger for: backend logic, API design, database schema, or non-visual code.
